These linguists include Longworth Dams, Major Mockler, R. Wiesblar, at the international level, while among the local researchers, Zahoor Shah, Kamil Qadri, Sardar Khan, Abdullah Jan, Aziz Bughti, Munir Badini, Saba Dshtiri, Shah Mohd Marri, Dr. Wahid Buzdar, Dr. Razak Sabir, Dr. Abdul Saboor, Prof. Dr. Zeenat Sana, Ghos Baksh Sabir, Dr. Inamulhaq Kosar, can be mentioned prominently.

However, it is essential to note that during Mir Chakar Rind’s time, another influential figure, Mir Gohram Lashari, led a significant group of Baloch Chieftains from various clans. They rallied under Mir Gohram Lashari’s banner, and his power was comparable to that of Mir Chakar Rind. Lashari’s centrality period was marked by years of strife and differences between these factions, culminating in the traditional thirty-year wars. During this extended conflict, one side would sometimes prevail, only for the other side to regain dominance in subsequent years.
